environment.description: Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate behind a public-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in us-east-1. ALB security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No WAF attached. Service is accessible at https://search-api.example.com. Route53 public hosted zone resolves to ALB. The format=html endpoint is reachable by any internet user.
